## `client.access`

The access-as-code calls of the platform API; instance administrators only.

### `client.access.export`

Signature: `client.access.export(scopes: Sequence[str] = ('instance',)) -> str`

Write the live access of some scopes as an access file.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scopes` | `Sequence[str]` | `('instance',)` | ``instance`` alone (the default), or environment names. |

Returns: `str`. The file's text; planning it unedited plans nothing.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.InvalidResponse` | If the answer has no text. |

### `client.access.plan`

Signature: `client.access.plan(text: str, *, file_name: str = 'access.yaml', allow_lockout: bool = False) -> AccessPlan`

Say what applying an access file would change, and every problem that stops it.

A file with problems is a plan with problems, not an error; nothing is changed.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | `str` | required | The file's content. |
| `file_name` | `str` | `'access.yaml'` | Its base name, for the messages. |
| `allow_lockout` | `bool` | `False` | Accept a file that drops the caller's own ADMIN role while another administrator remains. |

Returns: `AccessPlan`. The changes, drift and problems.

### `client.access.apply`

Signature: `client.access.apply(text: str, *, plan_fingerprint: str, file_name: str = 'access.yaml', source_commit: str | None = None, allow_lockout: bool = False) -> AccessApplyResult`

Make an access file's changes in one audited transaction, or none of them.

The server plans the file again and refuses when the file or access changed since the plan with `plan_fingerprint`. The request is sent once and never retried.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | `str` | required | The file's content. |
| `plan_fingerprint` | `str` | required | The fingerprint of the plan that was reviewed. |
| `file_name` | `str` | `'access.yaml'` | Its base name, for the messages and the record. |
| `source_commit` | `str | None` | `None` | The commit the file came from, 7 to 64 hex digits; recorded with the apply. |
| `allow_lockout` | `bool` | `False` | Accept a file that drops the caller's own ADMIN role while another administrator remains. |

Returns: `AccessApplyResult`. The apply's id and counts.

### `client.access.managed_scopes`

Signature: `client.access.managed_scopes() -> list[ManagedScopeBrief]`

List the scopes access files manage, for whoever manages row filters and masks.

Needs `MANAGE_POLICY` on the instance, not the `ADMIN` role; `status` tells an administrator more.

Returns: `list of ManagedScopeBrief`. Each managed scope with the name of its file and when it was applied, by scope.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.InvalidResponse` | If the answer is not a list of managed scopes. |

### `client.access.status`

Signature: `client.access.status() -> AccessStatus`

List the scopes access files manage and the open overrides.

Returns: `AccessStatus`. Each managed scope with its last apply, and each override not yet taken into account.
